developers.title: API keys
developers.subtitle: Take Zapp Pay on your website, in your app or at your till with the Merchant API.
developers.explainer.test: Test keys never move money. Payments they create can't be paid in Zapp Pay — you complete them yourself to try out your integration.
developers.explainer.live: Live keys take real payments into this wallet and can refund them. Creating one needs your PIN.

developers.keepSafe: Keep keys on your server — never inside an app or a web page. If a key leaks, revoke it here and it stops working at once.
developers.labelSubtitle: So you can tell your keys apart — for example Website or Till 2.
developers.pinSubtitle: Live keys take real payments, so creating one needs your PIN.
